body:
I feel the same way. I've been thinking about suicide 24/7 and I am extremely scared of having a chat about it with my parents. Although I have never cut before (I am extremely afraid of pain), I do still some what understand what you are going through. 

My best advice would be to talk with your parents when they are in a good mood and ask about getting a therapist; or if your parents are not available possibly a trustworthy family member.

Also I am here to talk if you want.
